added: Private orders now use one optional JSON boolean, `dark`, defaulting to `false`. For `LIMIT GTC` and `ALO GTC`, `true` makes resting quantity private. For `LIMIT IOC`, `LIMIT FOK` and `MARKET IOC/FOK`, it selects only private passive liquidity. Private FOK fills completely or cancels without fills. There is no displayed-BBO comparison, quote requirement or displayed fallback.

Individual trade publication depends only on the passive order: displayed passives publish; private passives do not. A private GTC can produce public entry fills and private passive fills after resting. Funding, marks, candles, volume and authenticated execution records still include all activity.

Order responses and active-order queries return `dark: true` for private instructions and omit default `false`. Modifications preserve the flag. The earlier draft fields `visibility` and `liquidity_pool` are retired and ignored in add-order requests; migrate those requests to `dark`. Private-order entry must be enabled by the exchange before `dark: true` requests are accepted.
